patch.objective: Troubleshooting configuration issues: API communication failures, certificate problems, and configuration-file syntax errors

sources.cite: CompTIA AutoOps+ AT0-001 V1 Exam Objectives, document version 1.2: Automation Coding Concepts 31%, System Configuration 25%, Continuous Integration 24%, Continuous Delivery 20%
sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch of CompTIA's PDF. Relevant text: 1.4 'Given a scenario, troubleshoot common issues with the code life cycle' (syntax errors, runtime errors); 2.4 'Given a scenario, troubleshoot common issues with system configuration' (syntax errors specific to configuration files); 3.2 'Explain workflow management concepts in CI' (automated rollbacks). The objective wording here is the course seed's.

Relevant text: systemctl status shows a unit's state and its most recent journal lines; enable creates the symlinks that start a unit at boot and --now also starts it; is-enabled reports it. journalctl -u selects a unit's messages. Read in full 2026-11-14.

sources.cite: nginx Beginner's Guide (configuration file structure) and Command-line parameters (nginx.org)
sources.note: Relevant text: Beginner's Guide, 'A simple directive consists of the name and parameters separated by spaces and ends with a semicolon'; Command-line parameters (nginx.org/en/docs/switches.html), '-t — test the configuration file: nginx checks the configuration for correct syntax'. Both read 2026-11-14. The [emerg] message layout, with file and line, is authored in nginx's style.

Relevant text: dpkg keeps a locally modified configuration file (a conffile) on reinstall or upgrade unless told otherwise, so reinstalling the package does not replace an edited site file. Read in full 2026-11-14 (the --force-conf* options section).
